fusions.name: Full-Length Sling
fusions.desc: Whirls a sling on a long cord and looses a jagged rock at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Unstitched Ground
fusions.desc: Rips the ground open in a cone 2.5 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mason's Line
fusions.desc: Strings a mason's line 6 tiles long ahead of you and a stone wall rises along it for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Pendulum Weight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a rock on a cord is drawn back a notch, up to 8. At 8 it swings: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per notch (163% at full). Unfed, a notch fades every 10 seconds.
